purpose: Machine-readable repository architecture contract for top-level ownership and lifecycle boundaries.

.github.note: GitHub-native automation boundary; remains at repository root by platform contract.

apps.note: Canonical container for maintained application source whose deployed URL layout is staged independently; contains the current Card Reference, Deckbuilder, Factions, Rules, Start, Playtest, About, Accessibility, Changelog, Contact, FAQ, Press, and Privacy surfaces.

card-design.note: Maintained card/component rendering and authoring system. Pure face-catalog and production-surface authority now lives under packages/rendering/, while card-design retains browser-facing compatibility adapters and environment-specific rendering/authoring implementation. Maintained design documentation belongs under docs/card-design/ and historical design studies under legacy/.

config.note: Maintained cross-system configuration; root placement is deliberate.

docs.note: Maintained documentation and explicitly archived development records, including current card-design standards under docs/card-design/.

governance.note: Decision provenance, schemas, traceability, and audit records.

images.note: Source and derived visual assets remain mixed pending asset-lifecycle audit.

legacy.note: Explicitly non-authoritative historical implementation/publication/source provenance. The archived Browser Rulebook is temporarily materialized at /rulebook/ as the v0.7.1 release-transition bridge until the v0.7.2 cutover.

media.note: Current reproducible media/composition configuration and export tooling.

packages.note: Canonical container for maintained shared packages and authorities; contains the complete current game-data authority, maintained active rules source/publication support, current rule-fact synchronization helper, and shared rendering model authority under packages/rendering/.

rulebook.note: Legacy monolithic Rulebook and version-specific compatibility support plus Rulebook QR assets. Gameplay authority lives at packages/game-data/current-game.json and maintained rules support lives at packages/rules/. The Browser Rulebook application source is archived under legacy/rulebook-browser/ but remains the deployed /rulebook/ release bridge until v0.7.2 cuts over.

rules-arbiter.note: Current static Rules Arbiter browser shell.

rules-assistant.note: Rules Arbiter implementation, retrieval, tests, and deployable endpoint.

scripts.note: Cross-project generation, validation, release, migration, and maintenance tooling.

tests.note: Repository-wide contract/regression harness; root placement is deliberate.

tts.note: TTS generation/packaging plus versioned release evidence.

v0.7.1.note: Lifecycle-selected current versioned public entrypoint; transitions to legacy when historical.
